scope: Decide only the morphological status of final -VAN as a place/location formative and its productivity boundary. Do not decide PARAZAMO/PARAZAMI, final -I, VANI semantics, KU/KE interrogative productivity, DAYI, grammar or curriculum in this gate.

attested_final_VAN_forms.note: Contains independently attested FROZEN VALI followed by VAN.

evidence.distribution: All three known forms ending exactly in VAN are FROZEN place/location nouns.
limitations: Only VALI is independently established as a base among the three forms; TAYO and PARO are not independently governed lexemes by this evidence.
Prefix occurrences VANI, VANUVALI and VANUVALAKALU have unrecovered meanings and do not prove suffix productivity.
Three aligned FROZEN forms support segmentation and semantic association but are insufficient by themselves to justify unrestricted derivation.

authored_registry_interaction.KUVAN: AUTH-001 is already a CANDIDATE authored closed locative specialization KU+VAN with productivity CLOSED_LIST_ONLY.
authored_registry_interaction.boundary: Recognizing a locative association for final -VAN does not automatically make KUVAN historical recovery, does not promote KU, and does not authorize arbitrary X+VAN forms.

options.description: Recognize final -VAN as a governed place/location formative supported by VALIVAN, TAYOVAN and PAROVAN, but keep it NONPRODUCTIVE/CLOSED_EVIDENCE: it may analyze attested forms and support already-governed KUVAN rationale, while every new X+VAN derivation requires a separate explicit authorship gate.
options.effect: Promotes morphological analysis, not open word-formation productivity.

options.description: Allow new X+VAN place/location derivations under a governed productivity rule with collision and semantic constraints.
options.effect: Creates productive morphology and should require stronger evidence/design testing than currently available.

options.description: Make no morphological promotion; retain -VAN only as a strong distributional hypothesis.
options.effect: Maximum conservatism but leaves the three-way FROZEN alignment and KUVAN rationale less formally modeled.
